newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market almost unchanged, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market almost unchanged, prices mixed.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed slightly down on Thursday despite gains in several small caps.
Traders said investors had been reluctant to buy and were waiting for fresh lows.
They expected the downtrend to continue next week.
Two independent market indices edged down on Thursday, while another stayed unchanged.
The VAB-RA all-share index slipped by 0.6 percent to 6,301.4 points and the BIG-OTC was 0,52 percent down at 4,520. points. The CAS-RQ closed flat at 990 points.
Advancers outpassed decliners by 175 to 102, while prices for 281 stocks marked time.
Oil refineries were among the heavyweights closing flat on Thursday. Arpechim ended at 39,000 lei, Petromidia at 43,000 and Petrobrazi at 46,000.
Cement maker Romcim was also unchanged at 120,000 lei in thin volumes. Steel wire maker Ductil firmed 100 lei to 3,600.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD and CAS-RQ on CRAS02 and CRAS03.
